qualification: Currently pursuing a degree in CS, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
description: Build scalable software solutions, collaborate with engineers on core Google infrastructure and applications, and gain hands-on industry experience.

title: Junior Frontend Developer

qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Web Development.
description: Develop user interfaces for Canonical's web applications and Ubuntu ecosystem using React, Vanilla JS, and modern CSS frameworks.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: Graduate students, young professionals, and artists from eligible countries.
salary: Fully funded (Tuition, living stipend, health insurance)
qualification: Completed undergraduate degree with a strong academic record.
description: Enables graduate students and young professionals from abroad to study and conduct research in the United States at top universities.

title: Imagine Cup 2025

qualification: Enrolled student at an accredited academic institution.

title: Associate Product Manager

description: Guide cross-functional teams to design, build, and launch products used by billions across Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
